title: Norboten
description: What learners actually did, straight from the database. The sample population is excluded everywhere: these are real accounts only. Provisioned from deploy/grafana: edits in the UI are not kept.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS accounts FROM users WHERE NOT seed
SELECT count(*) AS attempts FROM attempts a JOIN users u USING (user_id) WHERE NOT u.seed AND a.started_at > now() - interval '24 hours'

panels.title: Passed, last 30 days
panels.description: A lab counts as passed when every check was green after the reboot.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.passed) / greatest(count(*), 1), 1) AS passed FROM attempts a JOIN users u USING (user_id) WHERE NOT u.seed AND a.started_at > now() - interval '30 days'

panels.title: Rated attempts open now
panels.description: A rated attempt the server is still holding: it either gets judged or expires.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS open FROM rated_attempts WHERE open
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, count(*) AS accounts FROM users WHERE NOT seed AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', a.started_at) AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.passed) AS passed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT a.passed) AS failed FROM attempts a JOIN users u USING (user_id) WHERE NOT u.seed AND $__timeFilter(a.started_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Labs people are working on
panels.description: The ten labs with the most attempts in the range, and how they went.

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.lab_id AS lab, count(*) AS attempts, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.passed) / count(*), 0) AS passed_percent, round(avg(a.duration_seconds) / 60.0, 1) AS minutes_avg FROM attempts a JOIN users u USING (user_id) WHERE NOT u.seed AND $__timeFilter(a.started_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY attempts DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Events by kind
panels.description: What the API wrote down: progress an attempt reported, a question to the consultant, a stuck point the TUI saw.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, kind AS metric, count(*) AS events FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Ratings by topic
panels.description: Only topics somebody has actually played: r is the rating, rd how sure the server is of it.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.topic, count(*) AS players, round(avg(r.r)::numeric, 0) AS rating_avg, round(max(r.r)::numeric, 0) AS rating_top, round(avg(r.rd)::numeric, 0) AS rd_avg, sum(r.games) AS games FROM ratings r JOIN users u USING (user_id) WHERE NOT u.seed GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY players DESC, rating_top DESC
